name: Stitches Start To Tear
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 4, bloodlord 4, death mage 4, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a knife)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 30-foot burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You pull terrible entropic power to undo the healing those in the area have gotten. All creatures in the area must make a Fortitude save, for which undead, constructs, and objects are not immune, or take damage equal to 1/2 the damage they have healed in the last 5 rounds. On a success, they take 1 damage per instance of healing they received within the last 5 rounds. The damage dealt by this spell cannot reduce a subject creature below 0 hit points.
